entry_gate: G10 major report,audit,full-test acceptance and snapshots saved; inspect actual output-mode results before activation
question: For the fixed MVDR filters,how much of each result comes from true target-speech attenuation/distortion versus residual background noise? SI-SDR and recognizer errors alone cannot separate these mechanisms.
rationale: The simulated data generator provides a reconstructable clean multichannel field,which can support conditional linear-filter component analysis without assuming speech deletion or adding a restoration module.
candidate_scope: G10 original/fixed/rotated mask-MVDR,predeclared first seed20261112 only for adapters,all576 noisy cases each:1728 diagnostics. Exploratory mechanism analysis on already evaluated16 utterances4 speakers; not new independent validation or a best-seed selection.
reconstruction: Re-render each original clean FLAC with the same stored geometry,target direction,FIR and common_scale. Quantize clean multichannel field to original PCM24 convention and verify reference channel exact against saved reference. Define residual N=decoded noisy X minus reconstructed quantized S; quantization bookkeeping must be explicit.
conditional_decomposition: Recompute the exact frozen estimated-mask MVDR weights from X and its saved neural estimate,verify output against saved MVDR wave. Then hold those weights fixed and apply them separately to S and N. Check linearity y≈y_s+y_n. This is conditional filter analysis,not running the nonlinear mask estimator on isolated sources or claiming an end-to-end causal attribution.
candidate_metrics: Target-component SI-SDR separately,not a word-preservation label
Optional weight norm/white-noise-gain diagnostics with fixed declared aggregation
required_checks: Reproduced frozen beam output before attribution
Linearity error under a preset numerical tolerance
Known pure-gain and ideal noise-rejection fixtures for component metrics
No clean-condition0/0 noise ratios or silent fallback
white_noise_gain_caution: 1/(w^H w) is a normalized WNG only under the corresponding unit target-response constraint. With target/mask mismatch,report weight norm or white-noise power amplification unless the actual target response is also included and verified; do not mislabel inverse weight norm as true robustness.
limits: Only valid under the simulator and a frozen per-utterance filter. Energy distortion is not phoneme deletion. No real-room/hardware proof,ASR retraining,new model weights,dependency installation or SE training. Source/seed conditions remain dependent.
novelty: Classical component-response diagnosis motivated by Souden2010 distortion/noise tradeoff analysis; not a proposed new enhancement algorithm. Activate only after G10 archive.
